questions.q: What does LAN stand for?
Which of these is the strongest password?
Which of these is a web browser?
What is the internet?
options: A worldwide network of connected networks
A collection of web pages only

questions.q: You receive an email saying 'Your bank account is locked. Click this link and enter your password.' What should you do?
options: Click the link quickly and type in your password
Forward it to all your friends
Do not click the link; tell a trusted adult or report it as phishing
Reply with your date of birth

questions.q: Why is it a bad idea to use the same password for every account?
options: If one account is hacked, all of your accounts are at risk
Passwords can only be used once
It makes the websites run slowly

questions.q: The World Wide Web and the internet are exactly the same thing.
questions.explain: The internet is the network of connected computers; the web is the collection of web pages that is accessed using the internet.

questions.q: A WAN covers a larger area than a LAN.
It is safe to share your password with online friends you have never met.
Wi-Fi allows devices to connect to a network without cables.
A network that connects computers in one building, such as a school, is called a ____.
A ____ is software used to view web pages.
Software that is designed to harm a computer is called ____.
Unwanted advertising emails sent to many people are called ____.
State two rules for creating a strong password.
questions.answer: Any two from: at least 8 characters long; mix of upper-case and lower-case letters, numbers and symbols; do not use personal information (name, birthday); do not use a common word; use a different password for each account.

questions.q: Describe two things you should do if someone is bullying you online.
questions.answer: Any two from: tell a trusted adult (parent/teacher); do not reply; block the person; report the messages to the website; keep evidence (screenshots).

questions.q: Explain the difference between the internet and the World Wide Web.
questions.answer: The internet is the worldwide network of connected computers and cables (1); the World Wide Web is the collection of web pages and websites that you view with a browser using the internet (1).

questions.q: Match each term to its meaning.
pairs: Software used to view web pages
The address of a web page
A website that finds pages for a keyword
Text or an image you click to jump to another page

questions.q: Match each online danger to its description.
pairs: Fake messages that trick you into giving personal details
Software designed to harm a computer
Unwanted messages sent to many people
Using technology to hurt or embarrass someone
